title: Choose the console's visual world
question: The roll assigned Neraca Jaringan. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Neraca Jaringan
options.lineage: the shop's daily balance — the day's books closed until they sum under one hand, every count and every rupiah on the same beam
options.thesis: Health is one balance that must close: 150 bikes accounted for in four states, every rupiah reconciled.
options.viewport: A pine shell rail over one flat field: the four invariants in chips, then two balance beams — the fleet split across four states, the money a single closed bar.
options.risk: A balance only reports what it counts; a metric nobody feeds leaves the whole screen falsely calm.

raised.raise: One saturated accent reserved strictly for what can actually be pressed — nothing decorative is allowed to wear the action colour.
One dominant flat-colour plane per screen, so the balance reads as a single field rather than four competing cards.
Tabular numerics at true data density for every figure, so counts and rupiah scan as columns at a glance.

options.label: Papan Kendali
options.lineage: the operations control board — the row of gauges an ops desk watches all day, read standing up
options.thesis: Everything the network is doing right now, on one board you can read without sitting down.
options.viewport: A navy shell over four KPI tiles and five outlet rows, each row carrying a live count and a state dot.
options.risk: Also the arrangement most runs in this category land on — familiar, and familiar is not the same as finished.

options.label: Papan Gerbang
options.lineage: the departure gate board — flights reranked by time, a changed gate flashing and held until you have noticed
options.thesis: The day's returns run as a live board: the next one due at the top, anything late lit and held in place.
materials: one alert colour reserved for change
options.viewport: A segmented summary pass over a board ranking the five outlets by next due return, the late row held amber and never re-sorted away.
options.case: Fuses well: a row that reranks and stays lit is exactly how an exception should behave on a health screen — but the travel document is a costume worn by a bike network's own board.
options.risk: A boarding pass borrowed for a bike shop reads as decoration unless the rerank does real work.

options.label: Kisi Crouwel
options.lineage: the Wim Crouwel type specimen — letterforms built cell by cell on a construction grid that is left visible
options.thesis: The console's numbers set monumentally on the grid that built them, the grid itself the layout.
options.viewport: A faint blue construction grid across the whole screen, the four invariants set as monumental figures in its cells under one accent plane.
options.case: Fuses with discipline: an admin console is a grid already, and making the grid the visible armature is a real, buildable system — but the specimen is a poster about type, not a tool.
options.risk: Monumental type fights density; on a phone the grid can starve the data it frames.

options.label: Selubung Saville
options.lineage: the Factory Records catalog sleeve — matte black, a white hairline pulse plot, hue blocks standing in for words
options.thesis: Each outlet is a coded entry: a hue strip and a fac number, decoded only when you look.
options.viewport: A matte black screen with one white hairline plot of the day's returns and each outlet as a coded hue strip under a legend.
options.case: Fuses hard: vast unprinted black gives a slow console a real point of view, and code-as-state is committed — but decoding costs the visitor time on a screen that should answer at a glance.
options.risk: Black and coded is beautiful and slow; an admin checking health at 07:00 needs the answer, not the decode.

options.label: Peta Lobus
options.lineage: the zoo and gardens guide map — areas as swelling lobes of flat colour divided by their coastline
options.thesis: The network drawn as flat lobes of colour, one area owning each screen.
options.viewport: One flat green lobe swelling across a cream ground, a single capsule pinned to its coast.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the map is a place to browse, and an admin reading health does not want a landscape to wander.
options.kept: One dominant flat-colour plane per screen, the coastline doing all the dividing.

options.label: Baris Data
options.lineage: Ikeda's datamatics — dense barcode columns and sine lattices strobing in pure black and white
options.thesis: The network as a field of barcode columns, state read as a wave travelling across them.
options.viewport: A wall of hairline black and white bars with one sine curve tracing the lattice.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the strobe is an art statement, and pure black and white cannot carry the amber and red an operations screen needs.
options.risk: Unreadable where it matters, and it moves on a phone.
options.kept: Tabular numerics at true data density, so counts scan as columns.

options.label: Aplikasi Hangat
options.lineage: the warm consumer app surface — soft cards on a tinted ground with one saturated action colour
options.thesis: The console as soft cards on a warm ground, one colour for whatever you can press.
options.viewport: Rounded white cards stacked on a warm ground under a persistent bottom bar.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it is the category default wearing the category's warmth, and warmth is not what an operations screen is missing.
options.risk: Familiar to the point of invisible.
options.kept: One saturated accent reserved strictly for what you can press; nothing decorative wears it.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The admin console this category ships, executed impeccably: white ground, a left rail, blue accents, a sortable table.
canonCard.viewport: A left rail, a KPI strip, and a sortable table of outlets under a white ground.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
